criteria.name: Structure
criteria.guidance: Follows greeting → background → skills → projects/achievements → goals, with smooth transitions.

criteria.name: Clarity
criteria.guidance: Easy to follow; each sentence has one clear point; no vague filler.

criteria.name: Tone
criteria.guidance: Confident and professional without sounding arrogant or overly casual.

criteria.name: Conciseness
criteria.guidance: Between 80 and 250 words, with no repetition.

criteria.name: Relevance to placements
criteria.guidance: Highlights what a recruiter cares about: skills, projects, internships and career goals that fit the roles applied for.
